toolInput.query:
SELECT 
    s.s_suppkey AS supplier_id,
    s.s_name AS supplier_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(ps.ps_availqty, 0)) AS total_available_qty,
    SUM(COALESCE(li.total_supply, 0)) AS total_supply_volume,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(li.total_supply, 0)) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(ps.ps_availqty, 0)), 0), 2
    ) AS availability_pct
FROM supplier s
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT l_suppkey, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_supply
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_suppkey
) li ON s.s_suppkey = li.l_suppkey
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ps_suppkey, SUM(ps_availqty) AS ps_availqty
    FROM partsupp
    GROUP BY ps_suppkey
) ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name
ORDER BY total_supply_volume DESC
LIMIT 20

toolInput.query:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.o_orderpriority AS priority,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) AS month,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    GROUP BY o.o_orderpriority, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate)
),
prev_month AS (
    SELECT 
        priority,
        month,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
    priority,
    month,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(prev_revenue, 2) AS prev_month_revenue,
    ROUND(revenue - prev_revenue, 2) AS moM_change,
    ROUND(CASE WHEN prev_revenue > 0 THEN ((revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue) * 100 ELSE 0 END, 2) AS moM_pct_change
FROM prev_month
WHERE prev_revenue IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY moM_pct_change DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

toolInput.query: SELECT c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.o_orderdate) = 3 AND TRIM(o.o_orderpriority) = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY revenue DESC

toolInput.query:
SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS inventory_value
FROM supplier s
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty
ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC, ps.ps_availqty DESC
LIMIT 100

toolInput.query:
WITH efficient_suppliers AS (
  SELECT ps_suppkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_supply_cost
  FROM partsupp
  GROUP BY ps_suppkey
  HAVING MIN(ps_supplycost) <= 1.10
)
SELECT c.c_mktsegment, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM efficient_suppliers es
JOIN lineitem l ON es.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.o_orderdate) = 3 AND TRIM(o.o_orderpriority) = '1-URGENT'
GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment
ORDER BY revenue DESC

toolInput.query:
WITH efficient_suppliers AS (
  SELECT ps_suppkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_supply_cost
  FROM partsupp
  GROUP BY ps_suppkey
  HAVING MIN(ps_supplycost) <= 1.10
)
SELECT n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT es.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count
FROM efficient_suppliers es
JOIN supplier s ON es.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY supplier_count DESC

toolInput.query:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%W', o_orderdate) AS week,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS order_count
FROM orders
JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey
WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH')
    AND o_orderdate >= '1996-03-01' 
    AND o_orderdate < '1996-04-01'
GROUP BY week
ORDER BY week

toolInput.query:
WITH supplier_performance AS (
  SELECT 
    l_suppkey,
    COUNT(*) as total_shipments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l_receiptdate <= l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as on_time_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l_receiptdate <= l_commitdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as on_time_rate
  FROM lineitem
  GROUP BY l_suppkey
)
SELECT 
  s.s_suppkey as supplier_key,
  s.s_nationkey,
  n.n_name as nation,
  r.r_name as region,
  sp.total_shipments,
  sp.on_time_count,
  sp.on_time_rate,
  CASE 
    WHEN sp.on_time_rate >= 80 THEN 'Efficient'
    ELSE 'Inefficient'
  END as efficiency_category
FROM supplier_performance sp
JOIN supplier s ON sp.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
ORDER BY sp.on_time_rate DESC

toolInput.query:
SELECT r_name, COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
GROUP BY r_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC

JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
GROUP BY r_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC

toolInput.query:
SELECT 
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    s.s_nationkey,
    n.n_name as nation_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice) as total_revenue,
    COUNT(l.l_orderkey) as total_orders,
    AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) as avg_order_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as returned_items,
    COUNT(l.l_orderkey) - SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successful_orders
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA'
GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name
ORDER BY successful_orders DESC, total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 20

queries.query:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o_orderdate) as order_month,
    COUNT(o_orderkey) as total_orders,
    SUM(o_totalprice) as total_revenue,
    AVG(o_totalprice) as avg_order_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o_custkey) as unique_customers
FROM orders
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o_orderdate)
ORDER BY order_month

SELECT 
    n.n_name as nation,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) as supplier_count,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice) as total_revenue,
    COUNT(l.l_orderkey) as total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as returned_items,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(l.l_orderkey), 1) as return_rate_pct,
    COUNT(l.l_orderkey) - SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successful_orders
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA'
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY successful_orders DESC

toolInput.query:
SELECT 
    n.n_name as nation,
    o.o_orderpriority,
    COUNT(*) as order_count,
    SUM(o.o_totalprice) as total_revenue,
    AVG(o.o_totalprice) as avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
GROUP BY n.n_name, o.o_orderpriority
ORDER BY nation, order_count DESC

toolInput.query:
WITH supplier_nation AS (
    SELECT s_suppkey, n.n_name as supplier_nation
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
),
part_category AS (
    SELECT p_partkey, 
           p_type,
           CASE 
               WHEN p_type LIKE '%STEEL%' THEN 'Steel'
               WHEN p_type LIKE '%COPPER%' THEN 'Copper'
               WHEN p_type LIKE '%BRASS%' THEN 'Brass'
               WHEN p_type LIKE '%IRON%' THEN 'Iron'
               WHEN p_type LIKE '%TIN%' THEN 'Tin'
               WHEN p_type LIKE '%NICKEL%' THEN 'Nickel'
               WHEN p_type LIKE '%ZINC%' THEN 'Zinc'
               WHEN p_type LIKE '%ALUMINUM%' THEN 'Aluminum'
               WHEN p_type LIKE '%WOOD%' THEN 'Wood'
               WHEN p_type LIKE '%PLASTIC%' THEN 'Plastic'
               ELSE 'Other'
           END as material_category
    FROM part
),
lineitem_nation_part AS (
    SELECT 
        l.l_partkey,
        l.l_suppkey,
        sn.supplier_nation,
        pc.material_category
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN supplier_nation sn ON l.l_suppkey = sn.s_suppkey
    JOIN part_category pc ON l.l_partkey = pc.p_partkey
)
SELECT 
    supplier_nation,
    material_category,
    COUNT(*) as lineitem_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_nation), 2) as pct_within_nation
FROM lineitem_nation_part
GROUP BY supplier_nation, material_category
ORDER BY supplier_nation, lineitem_count DESC

toolInput.query:
-- Thread B: Efficient supplier nations (suppliers with high quality and availability)
-- Efficient = high lineitem ratio (more lineitems per supplier = more business)
WITH supplier_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        s.s_suppkey,
        n.n_name as supplier_nation,
        COUNT(l.l_linenumber) as total_lineitems,
        ROUND(AVG(l.l_quantity), 2) as avg_quantity,
        ROUND(AVG(l.l_extendedprice), 2) as avg_price
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, n.n_name
),
supplier_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        supplier_nation,
        SUM(total_lineitems) as nation_lineitems,
        AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_quantity,
        AVG(avg_price) as avg_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_lineitems) DESC) as rank_by_volume
    FROM supplier_stats
    GROUP BY supplier_nation
)
SELECT supplier_nation, nation_lineitems, avg_quantity, avg_price
FROM supplier_ranked
WHERE rank_by_volume <= 10
ORDER BY rank_by_volume

-- Thread A: Customer nations with distinctive order patterns
-- Focus on nations with high URGENT priority orders
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.c_custkey,
        n.n_name as customer_nation,
        o.o_orderpriority,
        COUNT(*) as order_count
    FROM customer c
    JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    GROUP BY c.c_custkey, n.n_name, o.o_orderpriority
),
customer_nation_priority AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_nation,
        SUM(CASE WHEN orderpriority = '1-URGENT' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END) as urgent_orders,
        SUM(CASE WHEN orderpriority = '2-HIGH' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END) as high_orders,
        SUM(order_count) as total_orders,
        ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN orderpriority = '1-URGENT' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(order_count), 2) as urgent_pct
    FROM customer_orders
    GROUP BY customer_nation
)
SELECT customer_nation, urgent_orders, high_orders, total_orders, urgent_pct
FROM customer_nation_priority
WHERE urgent_pct >= 24.0
ORDER BY urgent_pct DESC

)

ORDER BY urgent_pct DESC

queries.query:
-- Thread A: List all customer nations in the dataset
SELECT DISTINCT n.n_name as customer_nation
FROM customer c
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
ORDER BY customer_nation

-- Thread A with filter: Customer nations with urgent priority >= 24%
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        n.n_name as customer_nation,
        o.o_orderpriority as orderpriority,
        COUNT(*) as order_count
    FROM customer c
    JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    GROUP BY n.n_name, o.o_orderpriority
),
customer_nation_priority AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_nation,
        SUM(CASE WHEN orderpriority = '1-URGENT' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END) as urgent_orders,
        SUM(order_count) as total_orders,
        ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN orderpriority = '1-URGENT' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(order_count), 2) as urgent_pct
    FROM customer_orders
    GROUP BY customer_nation
)
SELECT customer_nation, urgent_orders, total_orders, urgent_pct
FROM customer_nation_priority
ORDER BY urgent_pct DESC

queries.query:
-- Thread B: List all supplier nations in the dataset
SELECT DISTINCT n.n_name as supplier_nation
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
ORDER BY supplier_nation

-- Thread B with filter: Supplier nations with high revenue >= $6M
WITH supplier_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        n.n_name as supplier_nation,
        l.l_suppkey as supplier_key,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) as revenue
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    GROUP BY n.n_name, l.l_suppkey
),
nation_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        supplier_nation,
        SUM(revenue) as total_revenue,
        ROUND(SUM(revenue) / 1000000, 2) as revenue_millions
    FROM supplier_revenue
    GROUP BY supplier_nation
)
SELECT supplier_nation, total_revenue, revenue_millions
FROM nation_revenue
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
